faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Impevos Studio, our products, and partnership opportunities.

items.q: What is an autonomous startup studio?
items.a: A startup studio (or venture builder) develops digital products in-house. Rather than being an agency taking client contracts, we conceive our own concepts, develop the software, and scale each product with dedicated growth, AI, and engineering squads.

items.q: How does Impevos decide what to build?
items.a: We systematically research emerging trends in consumer AI, mobile utilities, and developer tooling. We test hypotheses with rapid prototypes and greenlight projects that demonstrate exceptional user retention and product-market fit.

items.q: Are you open to strategic partnerships or investments?
items.a: Yes. We actively collaborate with visionary founders, technology partners, and angel/institutional investors looking to co-build or accelerate category-leading digital ventures.

Our stack combines native iOS & Android (Swift, Kotlin, Flutter), modern web architectures (React, Next.js, Node.js), and proprietary AI pipelines (large language models, multimodal vision, real-time audio synthesis, and cloud edge infrastructure).

blocks.heading: Controller
blocks.text: This notice is provided for IMPEVOS A.Ş. The street address, MERSIS number, and tax number will be added when the registry details are confirmed. Those fields are placeholders.

blocks.heading: Purpose
blocks.text: The contact form processes your name, email, company, and message. The internship form processes your name, university, department, and CV, so we can reply and review the application.

blocks.heading: Your rights
blocks.text: To use the rights in KVKK article 11, write to info@impevos.com.tr.

blocks.heading: Scope
blocks.text: This policy covers impevos.com and the mobile apps published by IMPEVOS, including Lumivolt: Energy Puzzle.

blocks.heading: Information
blocks.text: Browsing the site does not require an account. If you submit a form, we process what you type. We do not take payments on this site.

blocks.heading: Lumivolt: data on your device
blocks.text: Lumivolt has no account or sign-in. Your game progress and settings are stored only on your device and are not sent to us. Deleting the app deletes this data. In-app purchases are processed by Apple; we never see your payment details.

blocks.heading: Lumivolt: advertising (Google AdMob)
blocks.text: The free version of Lumivolt shows optional rewarded ads and occasional ads between levels, provided by Google AdMob. To serve and measure ads, Google may collect the advertising identifier (only if you allow tracking), approximate location derived from your IP address, product interaction and advertising data, and crash, performance and diagnostic data. Google's use of this data is described at policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites.

blocks.heading: Your choices
blocks.text: iOS asks for your permission before any tracking (App Tracking Transparency). In the EEA, the UK and Switzerland a consent form lets you accept or refuse personalised ads, and you can change this at any time in the app under Settings > Ad Privacy Choices. Buying Lumivolt Premium removes all ads.

blocks.heading: Children
blocks.text: Our apps are not directed at children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from them.

blocks.heading: Contact
blocks.text: For privacy questions about the site or our apps, write to info@impevos.com.tr.

blocks.heading: Necessary cookie
blocks.text: The impevos-consent cookie stores your choice from the cookie notice in this browser. No analytics or advertising cookies are loaded.

blocks.heading: Your choice
blocks.text: Accept and Necessary only both write the same necessary cookie. You can delete the choice in your browser settings.
